alt: A person holding a smartphone showing a live camera feed of the inside of their own mouth while brushing with the Dyson CameraJet toothbrush, with close-up teeth visible on the phone screen
story: Dyson's CameraJet, unveiled at IFA 2026, is a $499 electric toothbrush with a 100,000-pixel AI camera that identifies tooth gaps and fires precision mouthwash jets at them — and also lets you watch the operation live on your phone in real time.
why_funny: The phone shows live surveillance footage of your own teeth mid-brush, turning oral hygiene into a dental stakeout — 661 Dyson engineers apparently agreed this was the missing feature.
